first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: crowd of spectators along the route
entities.identification: A crowd of multiple spectators behind the barrier on the image-left, excluding the two-person group in dark clothing in front of the barrier and Person E.

entities.name: curved wooden ramp platform
entities.identification: The inclined gray slatted surface on the outside of the left turn ahead on the descent, with its outer edge raised; a partial red-and-white graphic is visible in the final frame.

entities.name: Person B
entities.identification: The cyclist in the first-person foreground wearing black long sleeves and white gloves and holding the handlebars.

entities.name: Vehicle A
entities.identification: The bicycle controlled by Person B, with a visible black horizontal handlebar, black front wheel, red front component, and control cables.

entities.name: track surface
entities.identification: The gray hard-surfaced downhill track between the barrier on the image-left and the wall on the image-right, leading to the entrance of the left turn.

entities.name: metal barriers along the route
entities.identification: The continuously arranged metal barrier frames between the spectators on the image-left and the track, mostly covered by banners early on.

entities.name: wall beside the track
entities.identification: The graffiti-covered plaster wall, exposed brick-and-stone-base wall, and yellowish-brown wall surface with dark red trim passed in sequence on the image-right side of the road.

entities.name: residential buildings along the route
entities.identification: The white and light-yellow and reddish-brown layered multi-story buildings in the background, with visible windows, balconies, and eaves.

entities.name: blue sky
entities.identification: The area of blue sky exposed above the buildings and vegetation.

entities.name: vegetation along the route
entities.identification: The green foliage, vine leaves, and shrubs in the upper-left tree canopy and beside the wall on the image-right.

entities.name: track promotional banner
entities.identification: The rectangular light-background banner on the barrier on the image-left, with blue and yellow-orange color blocks and text graphics.

entities.name: utility poles along the route
entities.identification: The slender gray vertical pole behind the spectators on the image-left, adjoining overhead lines near its upper section.

entities.name: cables along the route
entities.identification: The slender dark overhead lines in front of the buildings and sky.

entities.name: Person E
entities.identification: The person wearing a fluorescent yellow-green top and dark bottoms beside the wall on the image-right of the turn entrance.

entities.name: two-person group in dark clothing beside the track
entities.identification: The two people in dark clothing on the track-facing side of the barrier on the image-left, whose body outlines partially overlap when viewed up close.
